product: Benefits QA is a web app where claims reviewers at a benefits insurer filter, review, and audit insurance claims.

shipped.title: Save and reopen a claims filter
Share a saved filter by link
Add a note to a claim
Reassign selected claims to another reviewer
Date filter dropped the last day of a range

features.title: Export filtered claims
features.summary: Reviewers export the claims they have filtered to a CSV file, so they can audit them offline.
features.problem: Reviewers copy claims into spreadsheets by hand to audit them offline; with long lists this takes hours and rows get lost.
features.scope: In scope: CSV export of the filtered claims list with the shown columns. Out of scope: PDF, scheduled exports, exports of other lists.
features.result: Target met: CSV exports per reviewer per week = 4.2 against the target >= 3 (baseline 0, change +4.2). Window: 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-12 (UTC, half-open). Query: posthog events export_csv, distinct reviewers. Measured 2026-10-12 by `aayu measure`.

floors.detail: skipped: the Linux merge gate cannot run a screen reader

criteria.text: state: the claims list with filters applied; expected: Export CSV in the list toolbar downloads a CSV file of every claim matching the filters
criteria.inspect_judgement: The recording shows Export CSV in the toolbar downloading claims.csv, which holds the 37 claims the filtered list shows.

criteria.text: state: four of six columns shown with the Columns picker; expected: the CSV holds only the shown columns, in the order shown
criteria.inspect_judgement: The API trace's CSV header and rows hold the four shown columns only, in the list's order.

criteria.text: state: a list of more than 10,000 claims; expected: the list keeps responding while the file is prepared
criteria.inspect_judgement: The recording shows the list scrolling while the export is prepared on 12,480 claims.

features.title: Saved filters
features.summary: Reviewers save a filter of the claims list under a name, reopen it later, and share it with another reviewer by link.
features.problem: Reviewers rebuild the same filters (status, date range, claim type) by hand every morning, and describe them to each other in chat.
features.scope: In scope: save, reopen, and share by link a filter of the claims list. Out of scope: scheduled filters, filters of other lists, editing another reviewer's saved filter.
features.result: Not measured yet: the measure window opens on 2026-10-16.

criteria.text: state: a filter of status and date range applied to the claims list; expected: Save filter stores it under the name the reviewer types, and the name appears under Saved filters in the sidebar
criteria.inspect_judgement: The recording shows Save filter storing "Pending dental, last 7 days" and the name appearing under Saved filters.

criteria.text: state: a saved filter reopened in a new session; expected: the list shows the claims matching the saved filter's conditions at the time it is reopened
criteria.inspect_judgement: The trace reopens the saved filter in a new session and the list query carries the saved status and date-range conditions.

criteria.text: state: a saved filter; expected: Copy link gives a link that opens the claims list with the same filter for another signed-in reviewer
criteria.inspect_judgement: The trace opens the copied link as a second reviewer and the list query matches the saved filter.

criteria.text: state: a shared link opened by a reviewer who did not save the filter; expected: they can apply the filter but cannot rename or delete it
criteria.inspect_judgement: Rename and delete requests from the second reviewer return 403; applying the filter returns 200.

features.title: Claim notes
features.summary: Reviewers add notes to a claim, so the next reviewer sees why it was held or queried.
features.problem: Reasons for holding or querying a claim live in personal notebooks and email, so the next reviewer starts again.
features.scope: In scope: plain-text notes on a claim with author and time. Out of scope: editing or deleting notes, attachments, mentions.
features.result: Not measured yet: the measure window opens on 2026-10-16.

floors.detail: skipped: the Linux merge gate cannot run a screen reader

criteria.text: state: a claim's page; expected: Add note saves a plain-text note shown with its author and the time it was added
criteria.inspect_judgement: The recording shows Add note saving a note that appears with the reviewer's name and time.

criteria.text: state: a note added by one reviewer; expected: another reviewer opening the claim sees the note, newest first
criteria.inspect_judgement: The second reviewer's claim request returns both notes, newest first.
